title: Materialize one CFA3-wide Neural Rendering & Reconstruction Fabric
owner_approval_basis: User approved the final donor-aware plan and explicitly requested implementation through full closure.
decision: Expand the existing provider-neutral FA3 Neural Rendering & Temporal Reconstruction Fabric into the shared CFA3 Neural Rendering & Reconstruction Fabric for all current and future capability-compatible applications. Reuse existing Engine Selection, Shared Ray/Path Tracing, Render Dispatch, External Render Service, HRB, Model Router, Web-AI, geometry, evidence and plugin/extension boundaries. Add a common frame-surface contract, explicit feature classes and an explicit CPU software execution class. Preserve replaceable providers; OpenDLSS-NR remains conditional, while NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR and Intel XeSS remain provider slots only until separately admitted. Frame generation is presentation-only and is forbidden from canonical final/master timelines.
